C0132.title: Police–Enterprise Collaboration: Malicious "Wool-Party" Gang Defrauds 320,000 Yuan, Police Solve Case in One Month
C0132.summary: In February 2025, it was reported that in June 2024, the Taotian Group assisted public security authorities in Guangxi in cracking a case involving a malicious "wool-party" gang. The gang engaged in fraudulent coupon and promotion abuse on an e-commerce platform, with the fraud amount reaching 320,000 yuan.
